notes.title: The Him, the Smile & bloom Patch is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]IT’S HERE![/b]

The Him, the Smile & bloom Patch is now [b]LIVE![/b]

Thank you to everyone who has shown their support for Him, the Smile & bloom. The completed edit of the English script has now been patched in, so make sure to update your game!

With the new script, get ready to experience the story in a fresh new way.

If you haven't already, be ready to step into a world of romance and flowers in this refreshingly mature otome, following the lives of four couples centered around a local flower shop.

Remember to update your game!

notes.title: Him, the Smile ＆ bloom is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/34a1485fc68e8387011435a692485842b3b49b2e.png[/img]

[b]Him, the Smile ＆ bloom is OUT NOW![/b]

Enter a world where love and flowers intertwine. In this beautifully crafted, mature otome experience, follow the heartfelt stories that bloom around a local flower shop.

[previewyoutube=4HHxrQUN7vY;full][/previewyoutube]

Him, the Smile & Bloom offers different perspectives on the growth of adult relationships, capturing both the joys and challenges of modern romance. Rather than focusing on a single protagonist with multiple love interests, it explores the intricate connections of four unique relationships, each with its own heroine—featuring Wataru, Ginnosuke, Hokuto, and Tenya as the male leads. Through heartwarming moments and heartrending struggles in each relationship, the story offers an emotional and unforgettable exploration of love.

[b]Ginnosuke Sugawa[/b]
A client boyfriend

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/8a38d6b5ba20699f860ef7a154ccef6ec25c36c1.jpg[/img]

[b]Wataru Tori[/b]
A junior colleague boyfriend

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/1cf1ef3c46fbebc58d69b8a0d9274799f2a1b9e0.jpg[/img]

[b]Tenya Minami[/b]
Boyfriend from class

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/21e64a06fe9d837b8a055690d4fc30328bca9e15.jpg[/img]

[b]Hokuto Ichige[/b]
Boyfriend since childhood

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/98bb5e22102e054b8bd7bcd6756c5043d96cdeda.jpg[/img]


As if the story itself isn’t captivating enough, the stunning character artwork and expressive voice acting bring the narrative to life in a whole new way. The detailed visuals and immersive performances elevate the emotional depth of each story, making the experience even more unforgettable.

notes.title: Him, the Smile ＆ bloom is coming on 27th February!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/1f03209b6725ca5f19297777db25b58c1bcdc309.png[/img]

Him, the Smile ＆ bloom is coming on 27th February!🌸

Not long now until you can enter a world brimming with romance and flowers. This refreshing, mature otome game invites you to uncover the interconnected lives of four couples, all centered around a local flower shop, ‘Fill Flower’.

Experience each unique love story as it unfolds, weaving moments of passion, growth, and heartfelt connection. This visual novel will tug at your heartstrings, leaving you both warmed and broken. It offers a deeply moving and unforgettable otome journey.

    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278010/a5fc468a5674fe11de3b3fdafa17b553f11227e7.gif[/img]

notes.title: Him, the Smile ＆ bloom in PQube Asia's Showcase
notes.content:
Exciting news! 

Him, the Smile ＆ bloom was part of PQube Asia's first-ever showcase! 🚀

This incredible event highlighted the full lineup of upcoming releases for 2025 and beyond, and we’re thrilled to share that Him, the Smile ＆ bloom was one of the featured titles! 🕹️✨

Get ready, because Him, the Smile ＆ bloom will be coming your way in 2025 and we can’t wait for you to experience it.
